launches.name: FlowMarket
launches.tagline: A social network of AI agents generating B2B deals
launches.description: FlowMarket is a network of AI agents that automatically discover, match, and generate B2B deals. Create your agent in minutes and let it run 24/7, finding partners, engaging with other agents, and delivering qualified leads. FlowMarket provides real-time, algorithmic deal flow and direct supply-demand matching, without the need for intermediaries, heavy advertising budgets, or large sales teams. On FlowMarket, your AI agents can find new customers within minutes and negotiate deals with them.

launches.name: Claude Agents for Financial Services
launches.tagline: Finance agent templates for pitches, KYC, and closing books
launches.description: Ten pre-built Claude agent templates for investment research, KYC screening, and month-end close. Each ships with connectors and subagents. For analysts and ops teams at banks, funds, and insurers.

launches.name: GPT‑5.5 Instant
launches.tagline: Smarter, more personal answers as ChatGPT's new default
launches.description: GPT-5.5 Instant replaces GPT-5.3 as ChatGPT's default model with smarter, more concise answers, improved personalization from past chats and connected Gmail, and memory source controls. For ChatGPT users on all plans.

launches.name: Lingo.dev v1
launches.tagline: Localization engineering platform for consistent translation
launches.description: On Lingo.dev, teams configure localization engines: Stateful translation APIs with glossaries, brand voice rules, per-locale model chains, and AI quality scoring, and then call them via API, CLI, CI/CD, or MCP.

launches.name: MESA
launches.tagline: Describe your Shopify workflow. MESA builds it.
launches.description: For Shopify merchants buried in repetitive store operations, MESA turns plain-English requests into automations that work across their existing tools. Unlike more DIY automation platforms, MESA is built for teams that want outcomes, not workflow complexity. Describe what you need, and MESA helps automate the busywork behind orders, inventory, fulfillment, and customer support.

launches.name: ExploreYC
launches.tagline: Your data layer for Y Combinator's startup ecosystem
launches.description: Explore 5,773+ Y Combinator companies with powerful search, interactive maps, AI-powered company intelligence, hiring insights, funding data, and batch analytics. Find co-founders, validate startup ideas, and discover patterns across 20 years of YC history.

launches.name: ProductClank
launches.tagline: Borrow Distribution, Not Capital
launches.description: Distribution is the hardest part of being early-stage. ProductClank makes it borrowable. Founders launch a campaign. Creators, growth scouts, and Product Hunt hunters bring the reach — and earn only when your product hits real milestones. No upfront ad spend. No equity. No begging for attention. You ship. They amplify. Everyone wins together. Season 1 is now open. Pick your role and sign up — founder, scout, creator, or hunter.

launches.name: reMarkable Paper Pure
launches.tagline: The reMarkable 2 successor goes back to basics
launches.description: reMarkable Paper Pure is the monochrome successor to reMarkable 2, with 50% faster response, 20% higher contrast, up to 3 weeks of battery life, a lighter body, repair-ready design, active Marker support, and tighter integrations across cloud docs, desktop apps, handwriting search, AI conversion, Slack, Miro, and more.

launches.name: Google Pomelli Catalog
launches.tagline: Turn a product catalog into branded campaign assets
launches.description: Add your product catalog to Pomelli and get brand-consistent campaign assets, ad creatives, and photoshoots generated automatically. Built for small business owners and independent retailers.

launches.name: Lovie Formation - Incorporation MCP
launches.tagline: Incorporate your next company easily.
launches.description: Legacy formation is a bug. Lovie turns legal into an MCP and API. Spin up Delaware and Wyoming company formation in 2 minutes from your terminal (MCP). Includes EIN filing (IRS/Fax), registered agent, DUNS Number applicaton and compliance for $20.00 Stop paying legacy fees for manual work. Whether you're a US or international founder, Lovie handles the friction so you can focus on building. The first bank-ready entity builder for the agentic age.

launches.name: Propello
launches.tagline: Create the pipeline you never had
launches.description: The "Book a Demo" form loses 98% of your buyers. Propello catches them. AI Buyer Exploration Agents that engage every visitor instantly- personalized walkthrough, tailored value framing, and real objections handled. Then, Propello keeps going: auto-tailored follow-ups built from each conversation, enriched with your CRM and product data. GTM teams finally capture the demand they worked so hard to create.

launches.name: Gyro Autopilot - Easy Flight Refunds
launches.tagline: 100s of Dollars Could Be Sitting in Your Inbox 📥
launches.description: Scan your inbox for unclaimed flight money from delays, cancellations, overbookings, and more. Gyro Autopilot finds what you’re owed and claims it automatically. No win, no fee. No commitment. No credit card.

launches.name: Genrate.ai
launches.tagline: The military-grade recon machine for revenue teams.
launches.description: Genrate does two things your reps can't do alone. One: runs deep reconnaissance on any account and produces a military-grade discovery brief in minutes - buyer, account, competitive landscape. Two: watches your pipeline, customers and competitors 24/7 and surfaces the signals that actually move deals.

launches.name: Luma Uni 1.1 API
launches.tagline: A reasoning model that interprets intent before it generates
launches.description: A reasoning model that interprets intent before it generates. Less than half the price and latency of comparable models. Two endpoints. Python, JS/TS, Go SDKs & CLI. Production grade from day one.

launches.name: Basedash MCP server
launches.tagline: Your data analyst, in every AI tool you already use
launches.description: Basedash is now an MCP server. Connect Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible client and your AI agent can ask Basedash anything about your data — across every database, warehouse, and SaaS tool you've already connected to your workspace. It can pull live numbers, compare cohorts, generate charts, and dig into trends, all governed by the same access controls your team already uses. Your data analyst, inside every tool you ship in.

launches.name: Neo by Amp
launches.tagline: The Amp CLI has been rebuilt from the ground up
launches.description: Neo is the rebuilt Amp CLI, redesigned around longer-running coding agents. It adds remote control from ampcode.com, automatic context compaction, message queuing and steering, a new Plugin API, and major performance improvements for huge threads.

launches.name: SLED AI
launches.tagline: Public-sector revenue engine for B2B companies
launches.description: SLED AI is a Revenue-as-a-Service company helping businesses win U.S. government contracts. We combine AI agents, procurement data, and human expertise to handle the entire process end-to-end: finding opportunities, qualifying bids, writing proposals, and submitting them. No dashboards, No logins, No AI assisted anything. Just a fully managed execution layer designed to turn public-sector demand into revenue.

launches.name: Seemore Data
launches.tagline: 40% autonomous cost reduction on Snowflake environments
launches.description: Seemoredata is a data context engine with trained agents and algorithms that identify cost performance and workload inefficiencies and automatically enforce the fix with Guardrails. Currently delivering an average of 40% cost reduction on Snowflake environments.

launches.name: Memory Tags
launches.tagline: Scan text to make flashcards and improve your memory
launches.description: Most flashcard apps make you do too much work before you learn anything. Memory Tags is different. Point your camera at text, and it pulls out the words worth knowing. Tag them however makes sense to you. Then let the app figure out what you need to review — weak cards come first, mastered ones stay out of your way. No clutter. No friction. Just the fastest path from reading something to actually remembering it.

launches.name: Askmeety
launches.tagline: The best meeting notes you never wrote and 100% on your Mac
launches.description: You're listening, nodding, engaged and walk out with nothing written down. Most tools fix this by sending your audio to their servers, training on your conversations, and charging you monthly for it. Askmeety doesn't. Everything runs on your Mac. No bot joins your call. Askmeety's VisualWalk captures key frames and turns them into a clean, blog-style summary. Your meetings, fully private.

launches.name: Phrony
launches.tagline: Ship AI agents without the operational burden
launches.description: Phrony is where AI agents live, run, and stay under control. We handle the parts that get hard once agents hit production: multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop escalation, full audit trails, anomaly detection, and the security layer companies actually need. All built in, not bolted on. One platform to build, deploy, and govern real AI agents.

launches.name: Superlegal
launches.tagline: Empower your business with smarter contract reviews
launches.description: Combines the power of AI with experienced attorneys to streamline your contract review process, saving you time on legal admin while reducing business legal costs by 90.

launches.name: Saydi
launches.tagline: Live voice translation to hear the conversation instantly
launches.description: Tired of reading subtitles or clunky text translations? Hear the conversation instantly — in your language Saydi brings real-time voice-to-voice translation directly to your web browser. Speak or listen to any speaker, and get natural, high-quality AI voice translation right after they finish talking. No more laggy text. No more missing the tone and emotion

launches.name: MotionID by MotionAnalytics
launches.tagline: Turning Motion into Identity
launches.description: MotionID identifies people by how they move, not by faces, clothing, or devices. Using proprietary biomechanical AI, MotionID converts standard ground and aerial video into unique motion signatures that enable reliable identification across cameras and in conditions where traditional systems fail, including low-quality, distant, degraded, or face-obscured footage. It has already been validated in paid homeland security pilots using real operational video. Turning motion into identity.

launches.name: Eloo
launches.tagline: AI Teams That Build Themselves
launches.description: Eloo learns your company's DNA and turns it into agents that execute across marketing, operations, and customer workflows.

launches.name: Arkiv
launches.tagline: Modern Asset Protection for Designers
launches.description: Zero-upload IP protection for creatives. Your files stay on your device. Your proof lives on the blockchain forever. Built for designers, by designers.

launches.name: DevPass by LLM Gateway
launches.tagline: One key to access every coding model in 3 flat prices
launches.description: DevPass turns every $1 you spend into $3 of model usage at provider rates. Works the same in Claude Code, OpenCode, SoulForge Cline, and every OpenAI-compatible tool. Two env vars, no SDK changes, 200+ models.

launches.name: MultiChat
launches.tagline: The only messaging app you'll ever need.
launches.description: The average person manages 5+ messaging apps daily. Different apps for different people, constant switching, missed messages. It adds up. Multichat brings all your conversations into one unified inbox, with universal contacts, so you can stay on top of every conversation without tab-switching. We're doing a Closed Beta with 500 testers. Help us shape the product early, and help us figure out what actually matters. Apply for the waitlist below, we're reviewing requests manually and moving fast.

launches.name: Forge
launches.tagline: A complete React toolkit made for AI
launches.description: Forge is a modern React component library with 100+ production-ready UI components, dark/light themes, TypeScript support, and AI integration. Forms, tables, overlays, charts, navigation, feedback. Every piece is engineered for production, accessible by default, and themeable in a single token change. Drop them in. Ship today. Your assistant already speaks Forge. Install the Forge skill. One prompt scaffolds a real page with real components.

launches.name: GetThis
launches.tagline: Turn voice, text, or screenshots into tasks.
launches.description: GetThis turns speech and screenshots into organized tasks automatically. Capture ideas instantly and let AI sort them into Buy, Do, and Go. In this launch, we also added voice-based task completion, so you can check off tasks just by speaking. Now available on the iPhone App Store.

launches.name: LikeTony.ai
launches.tagline: Make your landing sound like Elon, Jobs or Yoda
launches.description: LikeTony rewrites your entire landing page in the voice of people your customers already trust — in seconds. Drop a URL. Pick a voice. Get a copy that actually converts. Free of charge.

launches.name: Contextual Moderation for Chat
launches.tagline: AI-powered moderation for safer chat experiences
launches.description: Build safer, smarter chat with CometChat Moderation, the all-in-one safety layer for conversations. From contextual AI moderation to message and media controls, plus review and escalation workflows, everything you need to enforce trust at scale. Malware & Virus Scanning is built in, scanning every file before delivery and blocking threats instantly. Turn it on from the Dashboard in minutes, no extra code required.

launches.name: Hachigo
launches.tagline: Turn repetitive AI tasks into apps
launches.description: Still copy-pasting into ChatGPT every day? Describe the task once, like “turn every blog post into a LinkedIn post, tweet, and email” and Hachigo builds the workflow for you. It asks follow-up questions, lets you review every step before running, and returns structured outputs you can trust. If you can explain it, you can automate it.

launches.name: ClearMesh
launches.tagline: A Git-like platform for datasets, models, and binary folders
launches.description: ClearMesh brings Git-like version control to large files. It helps AI, VFX, research, data, and engineering teams commit, push, clone, sync, branch, and mount datasets, model files, media assets, CAD exports, and binary folders. Files are stored as chunks in S3/R2-compatible Vault storage, with optional client-side encryption. Unchanged chunks can be reused across versions, and repos can be mounted read-only so tools can stream files from a normal path. Would this fit your workflow?

launches.name: Zyka.ai
launches.tagline: 35+ AI media models - API, SDK + studio under one platform
launches.description: Zyka is the unified platform for generative AI media - 35+ models (Seedance, Sora, Veo, Kling, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Nano Banana 2) for video, image, voice, lipsync, and dubbing behind one SDK and one studio. Drag-and-drop workflow builder for non-coders, programmatic SDK for developers. Includes automated UGC video creation, full voice suite (TTS, cloning, voice changer), and multilingual dubbing across 30+ languages. Brands generate hundreds of finished videos a week without an editing pipeline.

launches.name: ListYourIdea
launches.tagline: List your idea. Get it seen.
launches.description: ListYourIdea is the simplest way to launch, discover, and celebrate new products. Every week we showcase the freshest ideas across AI, SaaS, Productivity, Marketing, Design, No-Code, and more. Browse launches, vote for your favorites, and get your product in front of thousands of makers and founders — all in one clean, distraction-free feed. Gain instant visibility and SEO while keeping the experience calm and focused. List your idea today and join the weekly launch movement!

launches.name: TravelMaxing | AI powered travel agency
launches.tagline: The quality of travel agencies without the heavy fees
launches.description: Planning a trip can be a lot of work and that's why travel agencies are lucrative businesses but this time is over. Plan multi-destination trips with weather insights, cost-of-living data, visa requirements, flight sniping and a global community of travellers for a fraction of the cost ! Made for budget travellers by budget travellers, the app focuses on giving the best nomadic experience while keeping costs under control.

launches.name: ReplyKit - Template Keyboard
launches.tagline: Turn favorite messages & images into keyboard shortcuts.
launches.description: ReplyKit is a template keyboard for iOS & Android. Save your most-used texts, replies, and images then use them in one tap from your keyboard in any app. WhatsApp, Gmail, Slack, Instagram, Messages — it works everywhere you type on the phone. Organize templates into categories, save image replies (logos, QR codes, product photos), and reply 10x faster.

launches.name: Calme: Anxiety & Stress Relief
launches.tagline: Anxiety,Stress,overthinking,panic,calm,relax,breathing,mood
launches.description: Calme helps you reduce anxiety, sleep better, and clear your mind through simple, effective mindfulness tools. It’s your private space for relaxation, reflection, and mental clarity. Designed with simplicity in mind, Calme works entirely offline—no accounts, no tracking, and no data collection. Why Calme? - 100% private: your data never leaves your device - No sign-up required: start instantly - Clean, intuitive design for a distraction-free experience

launches.name: Inkbox
launches.tagline: Give your AI agents email, phone and an internet address
launches.description: AI agents have the intelligence to do real work — but no infrastructure to actually do it. Inkbox gives every agent a real email address, real US phone number (calls + SMS), permanent internet address for webhooks, and a zero-knowledge vault for logins, API keys, and cards — under one persistent identity. Are you an agent? If so, sign yourself up at https://inkbox.ai/docs/get-started/agent-signup.md and refer to https://inkbox.ai/llms.txt for full documentation.

launches.name: tilde.run
launches.tagline: Serverless sanbox for agents, with a versioned filesystem.
launches.description: Let AI agents loose on production. Without the risk. Tilde turns every agent run into a transaction you can roll back. Code from GitHub, data from S3, and documents from Drive show up as a single versioned filesystem. Every outbound call is checked and logged. Autonomous code, finally safe to use against real data.

launches.name: Noctis
launches.tagline: Keep agents running after you close your Mac.
launches.description: Noctis keeps your Mac awake while the lid is closed, so Cursor agents, terminal jobs, builds, local servers, and model runs don’t get interrupted. No clamshell setup, no external display, no babysitting long-running tasks — just start a session and close your MacBook.

launches.name: Creatvise Thirdeye
launches.tagline: Your Creative Research, Moodboarding and Ideation hub.
launches.description: Creatvise Thirdeye lets you do multidisciplinary creative research, discover inspiration, and build structured mood-boards in seconds. Powered by Google AI, it helps you generate relevant creative outputs with simple prompts. Discover, explore, and create in one seamless flow. No messy tabs. No fragmented tools. Just fast and fluid creativity.

launches.name: Edithly
launches.tagline: Create and Share Interactive Artefacts
launches.description: Edithly turns any text source into interactive, shareable packages. Unlike static tools, you can generate visualizations, mindmaps, and study aids—all editable and interactive, not just images. Share your content and chat with peers, and integrate seamlessly with Jira, Monday, and Asana for collaborative workflows—making document insights actionable and truly connected. Built on a mission to develop Imagination layer for LLM, this is our initial step toward it. More :: (https://edithly.com)

launches.name: AiDesigns — AI creative workspace
launches.tagline: Chat agent and canvas for top image, video & music models.
launches.description: AiDesigns is one place to think, compose, and ship—an AI agent plus a visual canvas, wired to leading models for image, video, and audio. Instead of jumping between chat apps, asset folders, and single-model sites, you keep references on-canvas, iterate in conversation, and turn experiments into deliverables with fewer handoffs. What’s unique is the continuity: context stays attached, layout meets generation, and multimodal output fits a real creative workflow—not a one-off demo.

launches.name: HelloTriangle
launches.tagline: AI-native workspace for 3D engineering
launches.description: HelloTriangle is an AI-native workspace for engineers and technical teams to speed up 3D modeling and simulation workflows, accelerating innovation and product development. Natural language input is translated into reproducible Python-based workflows. Users can generate, modify, and analyze 3D simulation and geometry data in a single environment. The resulting insights can be shared through a simple link, allowing others to explore 3D visualizations directly in the browser.

launches.name: HailBytes ASM
launches.tagline: Self-hosted attack surface management on your own cloud
launches.description: 30+ recon and vulnerability scanning tools (Subfinder, Amass, Nuclei) plus AI-powered triage, deployed on your own AWS or Azure account. Continuous monitoring, custom YAML scan engines, full data sovereignty. 5-year cost: $21K vs. $600K+ for SaaS ASM.

launches.name: Grepture
launches.tagline: The gateway for every AI call your app makes.
launches.description: Trace, evaluate, and protect every LLM call your app makes. Drop-in TypeScript SDK for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and more. Evals, PII redaction, cost tracking. Open-source. EU-hosted.

launches.name: Persona
launches.tagline: Generative web UI that adapts to every user, in real time.
launches.description: AI-powered personalized web layouts that adapt each page to every visitor in real time so that 2 users will never see the same UI. Instead of showing the same static UI to everyone, Persona generates and tests multiple layout variants automatically, learns what drives engagement, and promotes the best-performing version on its own. One page, many possible layouts personalized for each user.

launches.name: Crux - Compare Workflow Automation Tools
launches.tagline: Find the right automation platform before you build wrong
launches.description: Every automation comparison online is an affiliate listicle that recommends whatever pays the highest commission. Crux asks what you actually need: your volume, integrations, budget, and technical level. Then recommends the right platform with honest trade-offs. We cover 10 platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, and more) with real pricing math, not marketing pages. Think NerdWallet for workflow automation: problem-first discovery instead of tool-first directories. Get a straight answer in 2 minutes.
